scene: A dreamy night concert stage: light-blue and soft pink spotlights beam down through haze from the truss, a sea of glowing light sticks far below, white petals and sparkles float in the air, translucent ribbons drift, shining bokeh.
far_scene: The back of a dreamy night concert hall: light-blue and soft pink spotlights beaming down through haze from a dark truss, sparkles and soft bokeh.
